newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks broadly lower on jobless surprise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks broadly lower on jobless surprise.

text.p: U.S. stocks fell at the opening on Thursday, with the Dow Industrials, the Nasdaq composite and the S&P 500 Index all lower after the release of weekly jobless claims which were stronger than expected.
July construction spending data is due at 1400 GMT.
The Dow industrials was down 14 to 5,643, the NASDAQ Index off six to 1,137 and the S&P Index down two to 654.
New York Stock Exchange advances lagged declines by 323 to 676 and NASDAQ advances/declines by 622/972.
The long bond was off 18/32 to yield 7.15 percent.
